news.headline:
Shyam Metalics reported a 33.4% YoY revenue growth to INR 5,960 crores, with sales volumes up 26%.

Major expansions include INR 2,700 crores Odisha stainless steel project and INR 900 crores Kharagpur auto steel plant.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
Divis Laboratories targets sustainable double-digit growth and plans an annual capex of Rs 2,000 crore for expansion.

The company faces supply chain disruptions, elevated petrochemical solvent costs, and regulatory approval delays.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
Greenlam Industries posted an 8.3% YoY rise in Q2 revenue to ₹875.2 crore, while net profit dropped 22.9% to ₹24.5 crore.

Chipboard revenue jumped 123.9% YoY to ₹107 crore, while pre-forex EBITDA fell 19% to ₹86.5 crore.

Source: BSE
